Bike Sync 2.4.7

- Mirrors the eFTP displayed in Intervals.icu Sport Settings from the newest cycling fitness signature in daily wellness.
- Never substitutes the separate power-curve model or an activity-specific historical eFTP for FTP synchronization.
- Shares the matching eFTP, eW′, and ePmax with Bike Coach.
- Corrects the 311 W eFTP versus 295 W configured/model mismatch identified on August 17.
